faq.title: Preguntas frecuentes de admisiones
faq.subtitle: Clear answers to help you navigate your journey toward a global career.
faq.sidebarBody: Our admissions team is ready to guide you through requirements, intakes, and next steps.

items.a: Requirements vary by programme. For language courses, you typically need a KCSE certificate (minimum C plain) or equivalent to qualify for international placement standards.
We offer need-based fee reduction and support qualified students toward Ausbildung pathways through European partner networks. Availability depends on programme and intake.
Language courses run from about 3–12 months depending on the level (A1 to B2). Hospitality diplomas typically range from 12–24 months.

items.q: Do you offer internship or job placements?
items.a: We work with pathways and partners connected to opportunities in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Placement support is part of our career guidance — outcomes depend on qualifications, language level, and partner requirements.
Yes. We offer flexible learning options including evening, weekend, and hybrid modules for working professionals where available.

items.q: What career support services do you provide?
items.a: We provide CV guidance, application (Bewerbung) coaching, interview preparation, and visa orientation as part of our support for students pursuing European pathways.
Our language programmes follow CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages) standards. Always verify specific recognition requirements for your target country or employer.
